Connection requirements

Serve this page over HTTPS (or localhost). Your reverse proxy must route /ws/id to hbbs:21118 and /ws/relay to hbbr:21119.

Use the public key from your existing server data volume. The remote device must use the same RustDesk server and key.

Recommended: current desktop Chrome or Edge. This client requires WebCodecs. Native app shortcuts reserved by the browser may be unavailable.
